title: Light weave
description: Coral and white light travels through a suspended woven loop whose curvature changes under a direct drag.
useCase: Interactive light sculptures, expressive loading surfaces and procedural motion studies.
interaction: Drag the loop or adjust Twist; pause to inspect the light.
reducedMotion: Traveling light stops. Direct twist input still redraws the static geometry; host pause cancels a captured gesture and stops the clock.
limitations: Depth-sorted Canvas 2D strands, not a physically simulated fabric or ray-traced light source. The closed band has a bounded twist and no external assets.
look: Fine cream and coral strands form a twisted, translucent wireframe loop on a near-black plum field, with a coral slider and round pause button.
motion: Two bright pulses continuously circle the 32-strand loop, staggered per strand with soft glow; horizontal drag, arrow keys or the slider re-bend its twist between 0 and 180°.
adapt: Geometry is built in `project` and `geometry` (32 lanes × 144 segments) and lit in `paint`, where the `pulse` term sets light speed (1.1) and sharpness (exponent 18) and `hot` picks coral lanes. Drag maps to `change`; keep `cancel` and the reduced-motion branch.
